problem_statement: Calculate Ethernet wire-frame overhead and resulting effective MTU/MSS for encapsulation and VLAN scenarios.
inputs: Underlay MTU; desired inner MTU; VLAN tag count; encapsulation layer byte sizes; IP version and transport header options.
outputs: Total layer overhead; current and required wire-frame bytes; effective inner MTU; advertised MSS; frame-limit and risk warnings.
core_logic: Ethernet header 14 B plus VLAN tags plus payload/layer overhead plus FCS 4 B; derive effective MTU/MSS and enforce frame limits.
target_user: Network engineers validating Ethernet MTU, encapsulation, and frame-size headroom.
